results.author: MinhThanghus
results.body_snippet: ## Summary `tools/corpus_harness.py --bin hyb` validates the local file `./hyb`, but passes the unchanged bare name to `subprocess.run`. results.title: Feature proposal: a check for a prompt cache that is written on every call but never read (bounty requested)
results.author: nftkingiii
results.body_snippet: ## What happens An agent that uses prompt caching can quietly pay for caching and never get the benefit. If anything early in the prompt changes on every call (a timestamp or request id in the system prompt, tools in a different order, a changing user preamble), every call **writes** the cache and almost none **read** it. Cache writes cost more than normal input, so the run is more expensive than with no caching at all, and nothing in the trace looks wrong. neatroots has no check for this today.

results.title: parse_duration() ignores seconds
results.author: VARUN3WARE
results.body_snippet: `parse_duration("1m30s")` returns `60` instead of `90`. The `s` unit is accepted by the pattern but contributes nothing. `parse_duration("45s")` returns `0`.

results.title: word_count() miscounts extra whitespace
results.author: VARUN3WARE
results.body_snippet: `word_count("hello world")` (two spaces) returns `3`, and `word_count("")` returns `1`. Words separated by any amount of whitespace, including tabs and newlines, should count once: `word_count("one\ttwo\nthree")` should be `3`. Empty or whitespace-only text has 0 words.

results.title: chunk() drops the last partial chunk
results.author: VARUN3WARE
results.body_snippet: `chunk([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 2)` returns `[[1, 2], [3, 4]]`. The trailing `5` is silently lost. Expected `[[1, 2], [3, 4], [5]]`. Any leftover items should end up in a final, shorter chunk.

results.title: parse_duration drops the days (d) unit
results.author: tine1117
results.body_snippet: ## Bug `parse_duration` silently drops the **days** (`d`) unit.
